target_vintage: earliest evidenced official publication for each target period
seasonality: unadjusted; compare with seasonal-naive baseline, do not interpret raw sales growth as seasonally adjusted
candidate: previous-three-month momentum using t-1 and t-4 observations available by cutoff; continued over horizon
missing: exclude case; no imputation; record reason
revision_order: official evidenced availability time, never local ingestion version
adoption: experimental only; no automatic adoption from a short single-cycle sample
seasonal_naive: 100 * (value(t+h-13) / value(t-13) - 1), using only evidenced vintages at cutoff
